data.name: Aliona
data.gender_notes: Aliona is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew word 'eliyon', meaning 'my God is high'. The name Aliona is a feminine form of the Hebrew name Elion, which means 'God is my light'. This name was borne by a number of women in the Old Testament, including the wife of Eliab, the son of Jesse, and the wife of Ezra. The name Aliona carries the meaning “God is my light” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Aliona usually hope their child will grow to embody god is my light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing faith, devotion, and divine guidance.
data.etymology: Aliona belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God is my light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aliona total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.spiritual_significance: The name Aliona holds a deep spiritual significance for Christians. The name reminds us of God's presence in our lives and His ultimate authority and power.
